title: Hardware Profiles
description: Agate v1 — portable hardware-profile database for local LLM deployments. Each profile is a named physical identity with validated match predicates; a live observation is matched against this database but never rewrites it. Any consumer (Python, JS, Rust, Go) can validate against this schema before accepting an operator-edited database.

version.description: Schema version. Bump to 2 for breaking changes.

profiles.description: Named physical hardware profiles. Profile IDs must be unique (enforced by the Python loader, not expressible in JSON Schema).

NonEmptyString.description: A string that contains at least one non-whitespace character.

MatchPredicate.description: Case-insensitive substring predicate. Must contain at least one non-whitespace character.

MemoryGb.description: Memory capacity in whole GB; must be a positive integer, never zero, negative, fractional, or boolean.

VerdictTier.description: The policy verdict tier this profile resolves to (see model_hardware_policy.schema.json).

MatchConstraints.description: Identity evidence an observation must satisfy for this profile to be claimed. Empty or unsupported constraint sets are rejected.

notes.description: Human-readable physical/operational facts about this profile.
